# One-Sentence Summary

Primary methodological record for TASSEL workflows for association and linkage analysis.

# Scope for simitall

Use this record to ground recommendations about TASSEL workflows for association and linkage analysis. Preserve tool version, inputs, parameter settings, and a validation design in all generated workflow recipes.

# Agent-Safe Takeaways

- The method belongs in a workflow only after the biological question and input data are resolved.
- Keep analysis or simulation parameters separate from biological truth so each can be audited.
- Use appropriate quality control and benchmark outputs rather than relying on a single headline metric.

# Inputs to Specify

- Versioned input data and reference or coordinate metadata.
- Method-specific parameters and random seed when simulation is involved.
- A validation target, known truth, or independent held-out design.

# Expected Outputs

- Reproducible result files and an explicit configuration record.
- Quality-control summaries appropriate to the method.
- Benchmark or held-out validation metrics when available.

# Limitations and Guardrails

- This starter record is bibliographically verified but is not a page-by-page full-text extraction.
- The agent must not infer that the tool or resource is installed, bundled, or appropriate for every organism.
